data.name: Frontier Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Frontier Protocol drops you into the cockpit of a commander ship with one goal: grow your fleet and carve out your territory, one sector at a time.

Fly, fight, and mine
Take direct control of your ship in fast, top-down dogfights. Mouse-aim your weapons, manage throttle, and use boost to close distance or break away from a fight. Between engagements, mine resources from asteroids and rare asteroids to fund your fleet's growth.

Build your fleet
Every ship you add to your fleet expands what you're capable of taking on. Manage shield, hull, and fuel across your ships as you push deeper into hostile territory.

Explore procedural sectors
No two runs look the same. Sectors are procedurally generated, each with its own hostile presence, sites to raid, and hyper-jump gates leading further into the frontier. Frontier Protocol is built as an open-ended sandbox rather than a scripted campaign, how far you push into hostile space and how big a fleet you build is entirely up to you. A typical session runs about 45 minutes, however there is no fixed end point, sessions can run as long as you want.

data.short_description: A 2D top-down space combat and fleet-building game. Mine asteroids for resources, fight enemy ships for their parts, and capture sectors with a transport ship to push your reach deeper into procedurally generated space.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 capable GPU (NVIDIA GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon HD 7000 series, Intel HD 4400 or newer)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a Vulkan-capable GPU with up-to-date graphics drivers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated graphics or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
